Scenario: AI suggestion includes protected content; user revokes the field before reopening the draft
Required outcome: Original text is never returned; UI provides only a generic privacy-change explanation

Scenario: Revocation occurs in one browser tab while the suggestion is open in another
Required outcome: Open tab receives invalidation event and removes protected text before further interaction

Scenario: Client is offline when revocation occurs
Required outcome: Cached sensitive suggestion is unavailable until fresh policy synchronization completes

Scenario: User later grants the same scope again
Required outcome: Original invalidated draft remains unavailable; a new suggestion is required

Scenario: Support audit queries an invalidation event
Required outcome: Audit returns opaque references, timestamps, state, and policy revision—never suggestion text
State remains NORMAL; no matching or profile effect
ELEVATED_SCRUTINY or bounded RATE_LIMITED state; clear user explanation and expiry
Action-specific RATE_LIMITED; recovery review route remains available

Scenario: User with assistive technology has unusually slow or irregular timing
Required outcome: No penalty based on timing alone; action-specific data must meet more than one criterion

Scenario: Lantern is queried by matching service
Required outcome: Query is rejected by policy and logged as prohibited internal use
Differential privacy, if used, applies only to aggregate counts; no individual account decision is perturbed or exposed
